note: Environment variable NAMES only. Values are NEVER stored here or anywhere in this repo. Check drift with `npm run env:check`. Completeness is checked against process.env.* references in BOTH apps/web/src and packages/lib/src (SCANNED_TREES in scripts/check-env.mjs), so an undeclared variable is reported. This file — not apps/web/.env.example, which is a stale Sanity-era file nothing reads — is the authoritative inventory.

required.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY: Every Stripe call. Without it (or with a rolled key) the site serves perfectly and cannot take a single payment — /api/health/payments exists because that happened.
required.STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET: Signature verification on the ONLY fulfilment path. Missing or wrong = every paid order is silently never fulfilled.
required.CRON_SECRET: Bearer auth on all 19 scheduled routes. Missing = every cron 401s and the whole automation engine stops.
required.NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_API_KEY: Public by design (shipped in every page). Firestore is protected by the catch-all deny in firestore.rules, not by this being secret.

degradesQuietly.CLOUDFLARE_WEB_ANALYTICS_SITE_TAG: Cloudflare Web Analytics site tag; defaults in code to the public beacon token.

degradesQuietly.ALLOW_GOOGLE_PLACES_INGEST: Set to the literal string 'true' to re-enable the Google Places ingest, which is refused at the executor because storing and republishing Places data breaches the Maps Platform terms. Deliberately absent: re-enabling needs a licensing answer, not a deploy.

degradesQuietly.SALES_PHYSICAL_ADDRESS: CAN-SPAM postal address on outbound marketing email. UNSET IS A COMPLIANCE GAP: the fallback is 'CityBeat Media Group, El Paso, TX, USA' — a city and state with no street address or PO box, which does not satisfy the requirement. OPERATOR ACTION: set this to a real mailing address.

degradesQuietly.AUDIT_IP_SALT: Salt for hashing IPs in the verification audit log. Falls back to CRON_SECRET; same rotation caveat.

degradesQuietly.NEWSLETTER_FROM_EMAIL: From address on the weekly digest; falls back to the default sender.
degradesQuietly.REPORTS_FROM_EMAIL: From address on owner ROI reports; falls back to the default sender.

degradesQuietly.GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS_JSON: Service-account JSON for GA4. Falls back to the Cloud Run service identity.
degradesQuietly.GBP_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID: OAuth client ID from the Google Cloud project approved for Google Business Profile APIs.

degradesQuietly.GBP_TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY: At least 32 random characters used to encrypt Google Business Profile refresh tokens before Firestore storage.

optional.ALERT_EMAIL: OPERATOR alert destination only — never shown to a customer. Accepts a comma/semicolon/whitespace separated LIST (parseAlertRecipients in lib/ops-health.ts) and falls back to DEFAULT_ALERT_EMAIL, a personal address hardcoded there, so alerting works while this is unset. Set it to make that destination explicit rather than a constant in code. The checkout-recovery nudge used to read it as the address to PRINT to customers; it now uses SALES_REPLY_EMAIL, because a list and a personal inbox are both correct here and both wrong in commercial email.
optional.SALES_REPLY_EMAIL: CUSTOMER-facing reply address: printed in outbound copy ('write to …') and set as the Reply-To header. Defaults to the mailbox of SALES_FROM_EMAIL, so the printed address and the reader's Reply button always agree. Set this only when a dedicated support mailbox exists AND is monitored — the checkout-recovery nudge asks the recipient to reply, so naming an unread inbox is worse than naming none. One address; a list is reduced to its first entry. SCOPE TODAY: only the checkout-recovery route (plain nudge and Founders offer) sets a Reply-To. Every other stream — sales-agent, upsell, ghost-reports, comp-expiry, owner-reports, newsletter-digest, the unclaimed relay — sends from SALES_FROM_EMAIL with no Reply-To, so their replies keep going to that From mailbox. That is harmless while this is unset (both resolve to the same address) and becomes a SPLIT the moment it is set: pass replyTo at those senders' chokepoints before relying on it globally.
optional.ALERT_SMS_TO: Comma-separated numbers for SMS escalation on the failures that mean the business has stopped. Dormant until set (also needs the Twilio vars).
optional.ANALYTICS_EXCLUDED_IPS: Comma-separated IPs excluded from first-party page-view counts.
optional.CHAT_HOURLY_CAP: Global hourly ceiling on the paid-LLM chat endpoint (default 500).
optional.CHECKOUT_RECOVERY_EMAILS: Set to 'on' to let the recovery cron actually email customers.
optional.EMAIL_TIMEOUT_MS: Overrides the 10s hard bound on every email send.
optional.FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY: Firebase Admin credential as service-account JSON. Read by packages/lib/src/firebase/admin.ts, which falls back to applicationDefault() — on Cloud Run that is the service identity, which is why production works without it. Set it only where no ambient credential exists (a local runner, another host). A value that is not valid JSON is warned about and ignored, so a mangled one looks exactly like an absent one.
optional.FIRESTORE_DATABASE_ID: DISASTER RECOVERY ONLY. Unset resolves to (default). A Firestore restore always creates a NEW database, so pointing at restored data is this config change rather than an emergency code edit. See the DR runbook in CLAUDE.md.
optional.MEDIA_BUCKET: Storage bucket for uploads; defaults to kerstenblueprint-media.
optional.NEWSROOM_MODEL: Overrides the model used by the autonomous newsroom.
optional.NEXT_PUBLIC_CF_WEB_ANALYTICS_TOKEN: Public Cloudflare Web Analytics beacon token, embedded at build time from Dockerfile.
optional.NEXT_PUBLIC_GA_MEASUREMENT_ID: GA4 client tag, embedded at build time from Dockerfile.
optional.NEXT_PUBLIC_RELEASE: Release tag surfaced in error reports.
optional.OPENAI_API_KEY: Optional existing OpenAI integration credential; never exposed to the browser.
optional.OVERPASS_URL: Overrides the OpenStreetMap Overpass endpoint for citybeat-directory-ingest. Unset uses overpass-api.de, which is free, shared and periodically answers 502 'at capacity' — this exists so the endpoint can be repointed without a deploy. Any replacement MUST be verified global: overpass.osm.ch answers 200 in a second and serves Switzerland only, which would silently zero directory growth behind a green cron.
optional.RELAY_SMS: Enables SMS on the unclaimed-listing lead relay. Deliberately off.
optional.REWRITE_MODEL: Overrides the model used by article rewriting.
optional.SCRAPEFLOW_MODEL: Overrides the model used by ScrapeFlow extraction.
optional.SMTP_HOST: Preferred email provider when set (with SMTP_USER/SMTP_PASS).
optional.SOCIAL_IMAGE_QUEUE_ENABLED: Enables the already configured social image queue.
optional.TICKETMASTER_AFFILIATE_WRAP: Wraps ticket links for affiliate revenue.
optional.TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS: How many proxies append to X-Forwarded-For (default 1). Wrong value makes every rate limit either bypassable or self-inflicted.
optional.WORKER_URL: Cloudflare worker base URL; has a default.

platformProvided.K_REVISION: Set by Cloud Run. Surfaced by /api/health so a response identifies its revision.
